title: Use the shared modal action row to avoid clipped button focus rings
answers: The focus ring is cut off around confirmation modal buttons.
How should confirmation modal action buttons be laid out?
Fix clipped keyboard focus outlines in modal footers.
body:
Symptom: Buttons in confirmation modals show cut-off focus rings.
Root cause: packages/grafana-ui/src/components/ConfirmModal/ConfirmContent.tsx:ConfirmContent used a bespoke buttonsContainer and Stack for its action buttons.
Fix pattern: Render modal actions inside Modal.ButtonRow instead of the custom action-row wrapper.
Constraints: Applies to confirmation modal action layout; preserve button handlers, submit type, disabled state, ref, and test selector when replacing the wrapper. This does not establish a general defect in Stack.
applies: Confirmation modal action buttons rendered by ConfirmContent.
